payload: SI-1 Fleet pilot-status SSOT schema. Author docs/data/pilot-status-schema.json — a reusable template (JSON Schema or annotated example) that every future per-service pilot-status file MUST conform to. Required fields: pilot, charterRef, charterVersion, status (ACTIVE|DONE|FAILED), language, languageLockSource, openedAt, closedAt, closedBy, closureSignal, closureDecisionDoc, phase0, goals (G1-G12 each with status[TBD|IN-PROGRESS|YES|NO|PARTIAL|DEFER], verifiedAt, verifiedBy), decisionMatrix (speed/trust/scale verdicts + outcome). Derive the shape from the two existing CLOSED files (docs/data/pilot-status.json TA + docs/data/pilot-status-macro-indicators.json macro) — do NOT modify either; both are frozen/closed historical records. Gates pilot-3 (stock-price) Phase 0. ~1-2h, SSOT-only, no dev involvement.
constraints: main only; L84 explicit-file staging; no --force/--no-verify/--no-gpg-sign; no git push
